note: Derived on every run by tools/build-status.py. A hand-maintained status page is worse than none, because somebody plans against it.

design.name: API data lineage resolved
design.note: Every operation maps to the tables it reads and writes.

design.name: Operations declaring an auth model
design.note: A permission, an auth mode, or a declared audience. None may be silent.

design.name: Screens defined, specified and given a purpose
design.note: Loading, empty and error states written for each.

design.name: Configuration levels decided
design.note: Every configurable value has a scope level. Venue is the floor (ADR-0018).

design.name: Platforms with a unique name
design.note: No two platforms share a name in any document.

design.name: Contracts touched by a flow
design.note: Every contract appears in at least one journey.

design.name: State models
design.note: The denominator is status enums in contracts. Some models describe behaviour with no enum, so this can exceed 100%.

design.name: Tables with a relationship
design.note: The remainder are partitions, platform-written tables and caches, each stating why.

design.name: Screens with operations
design.note: The remainder are static, workshop-blocked, or navigation shells.

design.name: Requirements contracted
design.note: Read row by row from traceability.json. Excludes deliberately parked requirements.

design.name: Requirements with an artefact
design.note: An artefact class covering the requirement, not just a contract.

design.name: Operations reaching a screen
design.note: Not a defect on its own — sync, webhook and job operations have no screen.

design.name: Artefact classes
design.note: Three remain: device and hardware, retention (CF-64), performance targets.

design.name: Flows
design.note: **Raised from 60 to 120 on 24 August**, after the journey pass took the count past the old estimate and the invariant fired. The estimate was set when flows were being written one domain at a time; **walking the guest and staff platforms screen by screen showed the real surface is roughly twice that.** 120 is an estimate and not a commitment. Every flow written has found a defect — a till that could author the catalogue, a scanner that could create gates, a shift summary that could sign off its own review. **Counts authored flows only.** 72 more are derived from the client boards and carry `provenance: derived-from-board`; they route screens the client specified and do not yet say why anyone walks them, so they are scaffolding to write against rather than journeys already written.

build.name: Tables written
build.note: Counted from backend/. ADR-0024 said DDL waits for the design to settle; ADR-0038 and ADR-0039 settled it.

Operations reaching a screen.counted: an operation appears in the apis[] of at least one screen, on any platform
notCounted: screen-operation pairs — one operation on six screens is one, not six
per-platform tallies summed — that counts an operation once per platform
flow steps — an operation named only by a flow does not reach a screen
Operations reaching a screen.invariant: done <= total, and total equals the operation count

Requirements contracted.population: traceability rows that are not PARKED
notCounted: rows a contract claims by domain rather than by row

Tables with a relationship.population: tables in the schema reference, excluding cache: and vault: pseudo-tables
Tables with a relationship.counted: the table is either end of an edge in relationship-graph.json
